In Part II of the assessment, students circle a descriptive word and write one or two sentences using the frame "I think Kitten is acting ______ because I see _____," inserting their chosen descriptive word. This shows the student selecting and deploying a descriptive word in writing, partially meeting the "use descriptive words" clause — but the task is a single scaffolded sentence-frame completion with a pre-selected word, not the crafting of an engaging text. The "craft engaging texts" clause is not met because the student is completing an assessment response sheet, not composing a text designed to engage a reader. The lesson's primary objective is identifying and describing story elements (character, setting), not composition with descriptive language.
